productName: Astral Tabi Trail Boots for Siroino

reasons: The upper remains a provisional pattern draft. A combined side/rear collar trial passes individual paired-curve and stitch-direction checks in GarmentCode but creates a visible tangent kink where image-derived segments meet; the image-to-flat-pattern mapping is therefore rejected. Complete panel outlines, outsole clearance, tread, physical assembly, and footwear fit remain unverified.

Blender measured 15 Foot/Toe-weighted X-Z contour stations per foot; 10 close and five ankle-side profiles remain open. Adding LowerLeg alone introduces approximately 350-431 mm shin-height section spans and was rejected. These avatar-surface measurements do not define a shoe last, cuff, ease, contact, toe clearance, sole profile, or fit. The connected ankle-joint is measured, and the visual reference supports a raised cuff, but its pixel ratio has no scale calibration and cannot serve as a fit-accepted opening boundary. Three local horizontal cut heights yield stable closed avatar contours with a 146.92-148.57 mm body perimeter range, but garment ease, knit compression, and clearance remain unselected. Individual shape-key measurement shows the current base-body cuff sweep does not span All_Slim through All_M; no material-ease choice or garment shape-key transfer has been validated.
The generated footwear concept has not passed visualAppearanceReview.
No 3D source, fitted candidate, FBX, prefab, or customer package exists.
Avatar license and commercial release clearance are pending.
Product-specific Blender builder is not authored.

ossCombinationTrial.measuredOutcome: Pinned Blender 4.4.3 yields 15 bilateral Foot/Toe-weighted X-Z contour stations; 10 profiles close and five ankle-side profiles remain open. Normal GarmentCode draft-patterns/infer-stitches pass for 18 panels and 22 straight seams. A synthetic quadratic edge passes only on an unstitched strap outline. A real-avatar mask comparison found that adding LowerLeg creates 350-431 mm shin-height section spans; that union mask was rejected, while toe-island-preserving foot-only contours remain measurement evidence only. Blender measured connected ankle joints at Z=84.23 mm and a 180.98 mm weighted foot length. Visual inspection of the undimensioned side/rear concept supports a raised knit cuff; matching the side silhouette ratio to avatar foot length suggests a 98-108 mm opening height, but this remains uncalibrated. A real-FBX sweep at three reference-scaled cuff heights produced one closed, unbranched XY body contour per foot at every height; left perimeter varied 146.92-148.57 mm across the band. A GarmentCode/PyGarment sweep laid out three measured cuff candidates (-5/0/+5% ease) across the existing 18 panels; all three passed the 22/22 seam-direction audit with zero self-intersection, but the result remains a separate-panel 2D preview. A Blender audit of 99 individual shape-key extrema found a 134.35-155.84 mm cuff perimeter range across selected Slim/Medium/large states; global+regional stacks can extend it to 121.78-164.17 mm. The base GarmentCode -5/0/+5% panel sweep does not cover those variations. Blender 4.4.3 projected bilateral Foot/Toe-weighted XY body outlines for base, All_Slim, All_M, and All_L; SciPy 1.13.1 alpha-shape candidates were passed through the normal pattern adapter into pinned GarmentCode. Eight external-envelope panels pass 2D geometry without self-intersection; the body outlines are not outsole-fit results, secondary loops were omitted, and the concept's split-toe slot remains unscaled. The alpha contour cannot be called a tabi cleft: All_Slim's multi-crossing forefoot feature occurs behind the toe tip and is not classified as the design slit. An undimensioned concept-board estimate of a 20% split-toe slot was bracketed locally by 15/20/25% of the measured All_M and All_Slim body-outline lengths, with a separate 4.0 mm width hypothesis. All 12 panels pass pinned GarmentCode strict 2D geometry with no self-intersection. The 20% All_M variant is only a local visual midpoint; it has no material, clearance, upper-seam, fit, or 3D acceptance. Pinned GarmentCode/PyGarment processed a 20-panel local vamp-plus-outsole candidate with all 22 stitch pairs; all directions matched, all input seam lengths paired at 0.0 mm difference, and the panel layout had no self-intersection.
